name: Billy & O'Nare
text: Draw 2 cards. Then, if you have 10 or more cards in your hand, draw 2 more cards.

name: Boss’s Orders
text: Switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

name: Perrin
text: Reveal up to 2 Pokémon in your hand and put them into your deck. If you do, search your deck for up to that many Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Lana’s Aid
text: Put up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon that don’t have a Rule Box and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand. (Pokémon {ex}, Pokémon {V}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

name: Explorer’s Guidance
text: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and put 2 of them into your hand. Discard the other cards.

name: Eri
text: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you discard up to 2 Item cards you find there.

name: Morty’s Conviction
text: You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.  Draw a card for each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon.

name: Ciphermaniac’s Codebreaking
text: Search your deck for 2 cards, shuffle your deck, then put those cards on top of it in any order.

name: Salvatore
text: Search your deck for a card that has no Abilities and evolves from 1 of your Pokémon, and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck. You can use this card on a Pokémon you put down when you were setting up to play or on a Pokémon that was put into play this turn.

name: Bianca’s Devotion
text: Heal all damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has 30 HP or less remaining.

name: Kieran
text: Choose 1:  • Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. • During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon {ex} and Active Pokémon {V} (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Carmine
text: If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn.  Discard your hand and draw 5 cards.

name: Hassel
text: You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent’s last turn.  Look at the top 8 cards of your deck and put up to 3 of them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

name: Colress’s Tenacity
text: Search your deck for a Stadium card and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Janine’s Secret Art
text: Choose up to 2 of your {D} Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic {D} Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you attached Energy to your Active Pokémon in this way, it is now Poisoned.

name: Cassiopeia
text: You can use this card only when it is the last card in your hand.  Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Xerosic’s Machinations
text: Your opponent discards cards from their hand until they have 3 cards in their hand.

name: Crispin
text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards of different types, reveal them, and put 1 of them into your hand. Attach the other to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Lacey
text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead.

name: Kofu
text: Put 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you put 2 cards on the bottom of your deck in this way, draw 4 cards. (If you can’t put 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck, you can’t use this card.)

name: Briar
text: You can use this card only if your opponent has exactly 2 Prize cards remaining.  During this turn, if your opponent’s Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack used by your Tera Pokémon, take 1 more Prize card.

name: Drayton
text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon and a Trainer card you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

name: Surfer
text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.

name: Lisia’s Appeal
text: Switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Basic Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, the new Active Pokémon is now Confused.

name: Cyrano
text: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon {ex}, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Larry’s Skill
text: Discard your hand and search your deck for a Pokémon, a Supporter card, and a Basic Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Iris’s Fighting Spirit
text: You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.  Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

name: Ruffian
text: Discard a Pokémon Tool and a Special Energy from 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon.

name: Brock’s Scouting
text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon or 1 Evolution Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Black Belt’s Training
text: During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do 40 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon {ex} (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Cook
text: Heal 70 damage from your Active Pokémon.

name: Judge
text: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.

name: Emcee's Hype
text: Draw 2 cards. If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, draw 2 more cards.

name: Ethan's Adventure
text: Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of Ethan’s Pokémon and Basic {R} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Team Rocket's Ariana
effect_ops: conditionLess conditionGreaterEqual conditionLess effect conditionAlwaysFail effect
text: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. If all of your Pokémon in play are Team Rocket’s Pokémon, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand instead.

name: Team Rocket's Archer
effect_ops: condition conditionGreaterEqual effect effectShuffle effect effectShuffle effect effect
text: You can use this card only if any of your Team Rocket’s Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent’s last turn.  Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards.

name: Team Rocket's Giovanni
text: Switch your Active Team Rocket’s Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Team Rocket’s Pokémon. If you do, switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

name: Team Rocket's Petrel
text: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Team Rocket's Proton
text: If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn.  Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Team Rocket’s Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: N's Plan
text: Move up to 2 Energy from your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.

name: Fennel
text: Heal 40 damage from each of your Pokémon.

name: Harlequin
effect_ops: conditionGreaterEqual effect effectShuffle effect effectShuffle effect effect effect conditionAlwaysFail effect effect
text: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, flip a coin. If heads, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards. If tails, you draw 3 cards, and your opponent draws 5 cards.

name: Cheren
text: Draw 3 cards.

name: Hilda
text: Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Lt. Surge's Bargain
text: Ask your opponent if each player may take a Prize card. If yes, each player takes a Prize card. If no, you draw 4 cards.

name: Lillie's Determination
text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. If you have exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead.

name: Acerola's Mischief
text: You can use this card only if your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining.  Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play. During your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to that Pokémon by your opponent’s Pokémon {ex}.

name: Wally's Compassion
text: Heal all damage from 1 of your Mega Evolution Pokémon {ex}. If you healed any damage in this way, put all Energy attached to that Pokémon into your hand.

name: Grimsley's Move
text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck and put a {D} Pokémon you find there onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards and put them on the bottom of your deck. You can’t use this card during your first turn.

name: Dawn
text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, a Stage 1 Pokémon, and a Stage 2 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Firebreather
text: Search your deck for up to 7 Basic {R} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Canari
text: You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.  Search your deck for up to 4 {L} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Anthea & Concordia
text: You can use this card only if you have N’s Darmanitan, N’s Zoroark {ex}, N’s Vanilluxe, N’s Klinklang, N’s Reshiram, and N’s Zekrom in play.  During this turn, if your opponent’s Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack used by your N’s Pokémon, take 3 more Prize cards.

name: Waitress
text: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach a Basic Energy card you find there to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

name: Urbain
text: Draw 3 cards.

name: Tarragon
text: Put up to 4 in any combination of {F} Pokémon and Basic {F} Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Naveen
text: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. Before drawing cards, you may discard any number of cards from your hand. (If you can’t draw any cards in this way, you can’t use this card.)

name: Rosa's Encouragement
text: You can use this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.  Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Stage 2 Pokémon.

name: Jacinthe
text: Heal 150 damage from 1 of your {P} Pokémon.

name: Amarys
text: Draw 4 cards. At the end of this turn, if you have 5 or more cards in your hand, discard your hand.

name: Lucian
effect_ops: effect effect effect effect conditionAlwaysFail effect effect effect conditionAlwaysFail effect
text: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, each player flips a coin. If heads, that player draws 6 cards. If tails, they draw 3 cards.

name: AZ’s Tranquility
text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you moved a Pokémon {ex} to your Bench in this way, heal 80 damage from that Pokémon.

name: Philippe
text: Attach up to 2 Basic {M} Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your {M} Pokémon.

name: Roxie’s Performance
text: During your opponent’s next turn, their Poisoned Pokémon can’t retreat. (This includes newly Poisoned Pokémon.)

name: Emma
text: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you draw a card for each Pokémon you find there.

name: Misty’s Vitality
text: Search your deck for up to 4 Basic {W} Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. Your turn ends.

name: Gladion’s Final Battle
text: You can use this card only when it is the last card in your hand. During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon that don’t have a Rule Box do 80 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). (Pokémon {ex}, Pokémon {V}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

name: Rust Syndicate Grunt
text: You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent’s last turn.  Discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon.

name: Gwynn
text: Discard up to 2 Pokémon that don’t have a Rule Box from your hand, and draw 3 cards for each card you discarded in this way. (Pokémon {ex}, Pokémon {V}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
